input: variants.vcf: the 33 records of GRCh38-colocated (29 exemplars of its reference and four multi-allelic records at two of their loci), chosen because they mix single-base substitutions, multi-allelic substitutions, insertions and deletions on chromosome 21, so the plugin scores some alleles of a record and none of others

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

plugin_data: avi_scores.synthetic.tsv.gz (+ .tbi): a six-column AVI-shaped table (chromosome, position, reference allele, alternate allele, raw score, PHRED score; no header; chr-prefixed names; bgzip, tabix -s 1 -b 2 -e 2) covering the three positions around each record's position with every alternate allele, the reference base from the GRCh38 primary assembly, and no rows around 21:5030287 and 21:13610458, so those two substitutions take no score. The values are fabricated deterministically inside the ranges the plugin documents (AVI.pm:53 and 56: raw -1.3 to 4.0; PHRED the quantile of the raw value), not the published scores. The layout follows the six columns AVI.pm:161 splits a line into.
generator: variants.vcf and json_cache copied from tests/golden/116/GRCh38-colocated; the made-up plugin table as described under plugin_data; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus (the Ensembl VEP image's own AVI.pm, identical to release/116's); scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify --field AVI_PHRED --field AVI_RAW --field AVI_LINK
json_cache: copied from tests/golden/116/GRCh38-colocated: the pruned transcript shards its records reach and the variation slice that corpus describes; no run of this corpus reads the variations
